# Plot mutation burden
### after copying contents (*.burden.tsv) of work/08_wt_freq to working directory
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

BURDEN_DIR <- "work/08_wt_freq"
meta_path  <- "work/06_counts/sample_table_edit.csv"

meta_df <- read.csv(meta_path, check.names = FALSE)

burden_df <- list.files(BURDEN_DIR, pattern = "\\.burden\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE) %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
            mutate(sample = sub("\\.burden\\.tsv$", "", basename(.x))))

# Join to the edited sample table instead of guessing from regex
burden_df <- burden_df %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "sample") %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(frac = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Check that condition labels are now present and balanced
table(burden_df$virus, burden_df$condition)
burden_df %>% distinct(sample, virus, condition, replicate)

```
# plot 
```{r}
ggplot(burden_df, aes(x = n_mutations, y = frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_grid(virus ~ replicate) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Mutations per read in minimal element",
    y = "Fraction of reads",
    title = "Mutation burden distribution"
  )
```

# second summary plot (means)
```{r}
burden_summary <- burden_df %>%
  group_by(virus, condition, n_mutations) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_frac = mean(frac),
    sd_frac = sd(frac),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(burden_summary, aes(x = n_mutations, y = mean_frac, fill = condition)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ virus) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Mutations per read in minimal element",
    y = "Mean fraction across replicates",
    title = "Average mutation burden distribution"
  )
```

# scnv and beny data on Apr 7, 2026
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

BURDEN_DIR <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/htpmut/work/08_wt_freq/260327"
meta_path  <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/htpmut/work/08_wt_freq/260327/sample_table_edit.csv"

meta_df <- read.csv(meta_path, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

burden_df <- list.files(BURDEN_DIR, pattern="\\.burden\\.tsv$", full.names=TRUE) %>%
  map_dfr(~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types=FALSE) %>%
            mutate(sample=sub("\\.burden\\.tsv$", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by="sample") %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(frac=count/sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    condition_label=case_when(
      condition=="X" ~ "Xrn1+ (NOLEAD)",
      condition=="R" ~ "No Xrn1 (HASLEAD)"
    ),
    condition_label=factor(condition_label,
                           levels=c("No Xrn1 (HASLEAD)", "Xrn1+ (NOLEAD)"))
  )

cond_colors <- c("No Xrn1 (HASLEAD)"="#4DBBD5", "Xrn1+ (NOLEAD)"="#E64B35")

ggplot(burden_df, aes(x=n_mutations, y=frac, fill=condition_label)) +
  geom_col(position="dodge", width=0.7, color="white", linewidth=0.2) +
  facet_grid(virus ~ replicate,
             labeller=labeller(replicate=function(x) paste("Rep", x))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=cond_colors, name="Condition") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format(accuracy=1),
                     expand=expansion(mult=c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=0:max(burden_df$n_mutations)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0, 8)) +
  labs(
    x="Mutations per read in minimal element",
    y="Fraction of reads",
    title="Mutation burden distribution — HTPMUT 260327"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size=11) +
  theme(
    strip.background=element_rect(fill="#f5f5f5", color="#cccccc"),
    strip.text=element_text(face="bold", size=10),
    legend.position="bottom",
    panel.grid.major.y=element_line(color="#eeeeee", linewidth=0.4),
    plot.title=element_text(face="bold")
  )
```
